findings.trigger: Ledger FREE_GRANT +1, SPEND -1 (app hr), PURCHASE +5, SPEND -1 (app kb) (the ExportedViewModelTest fixture). Re-export hr from Tailored: SPEND count is 2, so Exported for the free application shows '4 left, was 5. Credits never expire.' instead of 'Free resume used... Nothing was charged.' Same after only buying a pack: FREE_GRANT, SPEND(hr), PURCHASE +5 -> re-export hr shows '5 left, was 6', a balance that never existed. findings.rule: data integrity of exported files; cross-lane #280 (Application detail file card Share/Open reads exportFileName); supersedes Reviewer A low #2
findings.trigger: This PR makes ExportDirectory.write reachable in production for the first time (ExportResumeUseCase -> AndroidPdfResumeRenderer). Every export, successful or not, deletes every file in cache/exports first. Export application A (A.pdf stored as A.exportFileName), then export application B: A.pdf is deleted while A.exportFileName still names it, so #280's Application detail Share/Open for A shows 'Couldn't find the PDF'. A failed render or rename after the wipe also leaves the same application's stored name pointing at a deleted file. Either keep one file per application (delete only the previous file of this application after the rename succeeds) or have readers re-export when the file is missing, and say which in the contract #280 builds on.
findings.title: Each export wipes every other application's PDF before writing the new one

findings.rule: Constitution II.5 (Tmr* components; TmrTextArea exists with a label and contentDescription); accessibility
findings.trigger: With TalkBack on Edit resume, each bullet field is a raw BasicTextField with no label or contentDescription, so it reads only as an edit box with the bullet text and no name. Sighted users see bullet cards styled exactly like the read-only summary and skills cards (export_edit_prototype_dark), so nothing shows that only bullets are editable.
findings.title: Bullet editor is a raw BasicTextField without an accessible name or edit affordance

findings.rule: scale (plan: PDF render is CPU-bound, at most two fit passes per page size)
findings.trigger: Each keystroke updates drafts, and mapLatest calls renderer.pageCount, which builds up to two native PdfDocuments with StaticLayouts for the whole resume inside a non-cancellable withContext(Default). Typing 5 characters a second starts a new full layout while the earlier ones still run to completion, so several fit passes run at once on the Default pool on low-end devices. Debounce the drafts (or compute the fit only on pause) before the page count.
findings.title: Full PDF fit pass runs on every keystroke in Edit resume

reviewer_a_adjudication.finding: A1 ExportedViewModel.kt:75 export runs in init and appends an ExportRecord on every entry
reviewer_a_adjudication.reason: NavigationState uses rememberViewModelStoreNavEntryDecorator, so the ViewModel lives per back-stack entry. Tapping Export PDF again is a real user re-export (new file from current settings and edits), so a second record is correct there. The defect is the process-death restore of an Exported entry (rememberNavBackStack is saved): a new ViewModel exports again with no user action, adds a duplicate ExportRecord and bumps updatedAt, which the account archive lists. Cheap fix: skip the export when the latest ExportRecord for this application has the same file name and is newer than updatedAt, or make the export an explicit action from Tailored. Low stays right.

reviewer_a_adjudication.finding: A2 ExportDirectory.kt:11 previous exports deleted before the new file is written
reviewer_a_adjudication.decision: confirmed and raised to medium (see my ExportDirectory finding)
reviewer_a_adjudication.reason: The failure path A named is real, but the larger effect is on success: every export deletes every other application's PDF, and #280's Application detail file card (Share/Open) reads exportFileName, so it breaks for all but the latest export. Today only the Exported screen reads the file, and it always reads the new one.

reviewer_a_adjudication.finding: A3 ResumePdfFitTest.kt:104 line equality records input text, not drawn text
reviewer_a_adjudication.decision: confirmed, low; accepted under D65 with a follow-up
reviewer_a_adjudication.reason: ResumePdfComposer appends to drawn before writer.draw*, so clipped or undrawn text would still pass. D65 accepts this until the D44 walk extracts text from the exported PDF; the follow-up instrumented test must stay in the PR follow-ups.
